_note: Sitting Michigan, New Jersey and Virginia state legislators, read from each chamber's official member roster on 2026-10-24. cmp-data.js carries a roster shell for every "rows" entry; "districtSet" names existing records that gained their district; "onFileAsCandidate" seats are left empty because the member is held only as a 2026 candidate row under another office; "nameSharedWithAnotherRecord" seats are left empty because another record or content key carries the same display name. Virginia delegates are filed as "Virginia State House Delegate", the title with the chamber named so the seat resolver reads it as the lower chamber.

notAdded.New Jersey General Assembly: Each of New Jersey's 40 legislative districts elects two Assembly members. The seat resolver places nobody on a seat two in-office records claim, so a pair of shells would still read "no member on file yet"; no Assembly rows were added.
